AnalyzeRequest.description:
The body of ``POST /v1/analyze``: the segments to inspect and how long to wait.

A service that cannot finish within ``deadline_ms`` answers ``failed: true`` instead
of keeping the caller waiting.
AnalyzeRequest.title: AnalyzeRequest

AnalyzeResponse.description:
The answer to ``POST /v1/analyze``.

An empty ``spans`` means the text was analyzed and nothing was found. A service that
cannot answer, or cannot answer in time, returns ``failed: true`` with a short
``error``; it must not pass an empty ``spans`` off as a clean result. A field a
service adds beyond these is ignored, so a service can extend its answer without
breaking its callers.
AnalyzeResponse.title: AnalyzeResponse

AnalyzeSegment.description:
A piece of text to analyze.

``id`` is opaque to the service and comes back as ``AnalyzeSpan.segment_id``.
``lang`` is a language hint: any language code the caller has, or ``None`` when it
does not know the language. The service decides which codes it supports.
AnalyzeSegment.title: AnalyzeSegment

AnalyzeSpan.description:
One finding inside a segment of the request.

``start`` and ``end`` are offsets into the text of the segment named by
``segment_id``. They count Unicode code points, as a Python ``str`` index does, and
``end`` is exclusive. ``score`` is a confidence between 0 and 1. A field a service
adds beyond these is ignored, so a service can extend its answer without breaking
its callers.
AnalyzeSpan.title: AnalyzeSpan

bearerAuth.description: Optional. A service that requires a token expects it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

info.description: What a service that finds entities in text answers to a remote detector. Anyone can implement it and point a policy document at it. Generated from the models in donkit_guard.adapters by scripts/gen_contract.py: change the models, not this file.
info.title: donkit-guard analyze contract

get.description: Optional. A service may expose it so that orchestrators and operators can see that it is up. The analyze contract does not depend on it, and its body is not specified.

200.description: The service is up. The body can be anything.

get.summary: Check that the service is up (optional)

post.description: Finds entities in each segment of the request and reports each as a span. Offsets count Unicode code points into the text of the segment the span names, as a Python `str` index does, and `end` is exclusive. A service that cannot answer within `deadline_ms` answers `failed: true` with a short `error` instead of keeping the caller waiting, and never passes an empty `spans` off as a clean result; the spans of a failed answer are ignored. A field the service adds to its answer beyond those listed is ignored.

200.description: The segments were analyzed, or the service reports with `failed: true` that it could not analyze them.

default.description: Any other status. The caller treats the call as failed and does not read the body.
